title: Downgrading the minimum numpy version to 2.1.3.
body:
Is it possible to downgrade the minimum numpy version to 2.1.3? I am having issues integrating mcp-agent into our project because of our dependency on numba, which hasn't yet upgraded to numpy 2.2.

I have no idea if this is even a valid request to make.
author: Nicba1010
